claim: AW22 / A-049 (analytics walk 2026-10-03): /calendar dropped the takings its own API returned. At 8c673db4b the gateway summed the GROSS pos_checks.total into recorded.sales (recorded-days.service.ts:129-130, select :165) and no web file drew it, so the $7,709.52 street-fair booth changed nothing on the page. ADR 0287 (Locked on the founder's AW22 'Day panel only (Recommended)' and AW17 'Net sales (Recommended)'; the audience is built as F1 option (b) on his own words of 2026-10-04, 'authorized ones see everything others only see actions', and his confirmation of that reading is owed [2026-10-07: this said 'Locked on ... his F1 answer'; the audit at 31c5ec562 found no pick of (b)]): the opened day (DayLedger: month panel and Day view) shows NET takings, the sum of pos_checks.subtotal, in the house currency, beside covers, to owners and managers; the month cell stays covers-only; any role below manager, or none, gets the days with netSales, netSalesCheckCount and currency omitted and takingsWithheld: true. The verify strips comments and requires (1) recorded-days.service.ts's one pos_checks money read (the select('id') probe aside) selects subtotal and no total column, with or without the select's options argument; (2) foldChecksToDays reads row.subtotal and names no total at all; (3) day-record.service.ts's prediction_outcomes actual_value writes netSales from d.recorded?.netSales and no bare sales key; (4) SkyMark.tsx exports TakingsMark reading netSales while DayRecordMark's body never names netSales; (5) MonthLedger.tsx draws <TakingsMark inside DayLedger and names TakingsMark nowhere in the month grid; (6) calendar.controller.ts getDayRecord sets seesHouseMoney = roleSatisfies(user.role, "manager") and passes it to windowFor, with no literal true/false; (7) day-record.service.ts windowFor returns withholdHouseMoney(window) unless seesHouseMoney === true, and withholdHouseMoney's allowlist names no netSales or currency and sets takingsWithheld: true; (8) TakingsMark returns null when withheld and DayLedger passes withheld from takingsWithheld; (9) that read projects id, asks count: "exact" and is the build() of a readWholeWindow call (ADR 0292, merged in #609), so a month past PostgREST's 1,000 rows is summed whole or refused; (10) day-record.service.ts calls keepPairs once, only when the ledger's refusal is null, else pairsWritten is 0, so a refused register never freezes a pair; (11) TakingsMark returns null when refused and DayLedger passes refused from the window's recordedRefusal.
